description: Optional inspiration palette of structural patterns. NOT consulted by runtime routing.

structures.name: Linear flow
structures.description: Strictly sequential user-action / system-response steps without branches. Default for onboarding and checkout flows.

structures.name: Branched flow
structures.description: User-action / system-response steps with decision points and alternate paths. Used for flows where the user's input or state determines the next step.

structures.name: Hub-and-spoke IA
structures.description: A primary landing point with spokes to task surfaces; users return to the hub between tasks. Common in dashboards.

structures.name: Wizard structure
structures.description: Multi-step task broken into discrete linear screens with progress indication. Used when the task is complex but the steps are well-bounded.

structures.name: Progressive disclosure
structures.description: Reveal complexity gradually as the user demonstrates need. Defaults to the simplest surface; expert affordances surface on demand.

structures.name: Stage table (journey)
structures.description: Time-ordered stages × per-stage dimensions (user state, touchpoint, emotion, opportunity). Used for journey maps.

structures.name: Decision matrix
structures.description: Options × criteria with per-cell scores or qualitative tags. Used for trade-off-heavy decisions where the criteria are explicit.

structures.name: Card grid
structures.description: Items × attributes laid out as cards; supports filtering and grouping. Used for browse-and-pick surfaces.
